idea_text:
The revised device encloses the black tin sheet inside an insulated wooden box with two strategically placed openings; solar‑heated air enters through the lower opening, rises naturally, and a small solar‑powered fan pushes it across a mesh tray for drying, eliminating the need for extensive valve networks, underground tanks, and multiple electronic fans.

claim_chart.candidate_text:
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of fruit and vegetable drying, in particular to a novel solar-driven tube-fin type hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device, comprising a solar photovoltaic photothermal system and a tube-fin type hot air drying system. One side of the solar photovoltaic photothermal system is provided with tube fins Hot air drying system. This new type of solar-powered tube-fin type hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device uses the solar photovoltaic photothermal system to convert the absorbed solar energy into electrical energy and internal energy, which are used to drive pumps and fans, and heat the water in the water tank. High-efficiency solar energy is used. As a drying heat source, the photovoltaic photothermal system overcomes the problem of high energy consumption of the currently widely used electric hot air drying system, thereby achieving the effect of energy saving and emission reduction. The main equipment of the tube-fin type hot air drying system is a heat exchanger. Each heat exchanger is connected in parallel with the water tank to form a circulating water circuit. moisture to achieve the purpose of drying fruits and vegetables.

data.plain_summary: You’ve built a simple box that lets sun‑heated air flow in at the bottom, rise up, and be pushed by a tiny solar fan across a mesh tray. Similar ideas already exist – for example, a DIY solar dehydrator that uses a wooden box with bottom inlet and top outlet, and a solar‑driven tobacco curing house that also has a roof‑mounted solar panel and a circulation fan. What sets yours apart is the combination of an insulated wooden box, a dedicated mesh tray, and a small solar fan, but many of those elements appear in prior designs. To make your concept stand out, consider adding a heat‑storage layer or a smart variable‑speed fan that adjusts flow based on temperature, and channel the heated air directly over the tray with an insulated duct.

localized.plain_summary: आपने एक सरल बॉक्स बनाया है जो नीचे से सूर्य‑तापित हवा को अंदर आने देता है, ऊपर उठती है, और एक छोटे सौर पंखे द्वारा जाली वाले ट्रे के ऊपर धकेली जाती है। इसी तरह के विचार पहले से मौजूद हैं – उदाहरण के तौर पर, एक DIY सौर डिहाइड्रेटर जो नीचे इनलेट और ऊपर आउटलेट वाले लकड़ी के बॉक्स का उपयोग करता है, और एक सौर‑चालित तंबाकू क्योरिंग हाउस जिसमें छत‑पर सौर पैनल और सर्कुलेशन फैन होता है। आपका विचार अलग बनाता है इन्सुलेटेड लकड़ी का बॉक्स, समर्पित जाली ट्रे, और छोटा सौर पैनल फैन का संयोजन, लेकिन इन तत्वों में से कई पहले के डिज़ाइनों में भी मिलते हैं। आपके कॉन्सेप्ट को अलग दिखाने के लिए, एक हीट‑स्टोरेज लेयर या एक स्मार्ट वैरिएबल‑स्पीड फैन जोड़ने पर विचार करें जो तापमान के आधार पर प्रवाह को समायोजित करे, और गर्म हवा को सीधे ट्रे के ऊपर इन्सुलेटेड डक्ट के माध्यम से चैनल करें।
differentiation_suggestions: एक द्वितीयक हीट‑स्टोरेज लेयर (जैसे, फेज‑चेंज मैटेरियल) लकड़ी के बॉक्स के अंदर जोड़ें ताकि तापमान में उतार‑चढ़ाव को स्मूद किया जा सके।
एक कंट्रोलेबल सौर‑पावर्ड वैरिएबल‑स्पीड फैन इंटीग्रेट करें जो आंतरिक तापमान सेंसर के आधार पर प्रवाह को मॉड्यूलेट करे।
एक सील्ड, इन्सुलेटेड एयर‑डक्ट चैनल प्रदान करें जो सौर‑तापित हवा को सीधे जाली ट्रे के ऊपर ले जाए, जिससे पर्यावरणीय हवा के साथ मिश्रण कम हो।

examined_documents.title: Novel solar-driven tube-fin type heated air circulation fruit and vegetable …
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of fruit and vegetable drying, in particular to a novel solar-driven tube-fin type hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device, comprising a solar photovoltaic photothermal system and a tube-fin type hot air drying system. One side of the solar photovoltaic photothermal system is provided with tube fins Hot air drying system. This new type of solar-powered tube-fin type hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device uses the solar photovoltaic photothermal system to convert the absorbed solar energy into electrical energy and internal energy, which are used to drive pumps and fans, and heat the water in the water tank. High-efficiency solar energy is used. As a drying heat source, the photovoltaic photothermal system overcomes the problem of high energy consumption of the currently widely used electric hot air drying system, thereby achieving the effect of energy saving and emission reduction. The main equipment of the tube-fin type hot air drying system is a heat exchanger. Each heat exchanger is connected in parallel with the water tank to form a circulating water circuit. moisture to achieve the purpose of drying fruits and vegetables.

Claim 1: 1. The utility model provides a novel solar energy driven pipe wing formula heated air circulation fruit vegetables drying device, includes solar photovoltaic photo-thermal system and pipe wing formula heated air drying system, its characterized in that: a tube-fin hot air drying system is arranged on one side of the solar photovoltaic photo-thermal system, and a water return pipe (23) and a water supply pipe (24) are arranged between the solar photovoltaic photo-thermal system and the tube-fin hot air drying system.

Claim 2: 2. The novel solar-driven tube-fin hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device is characterized in that: the solar photovoltaic photo-thermal system comprises a support frame, a photovoltaic panel (15), a microchannel flat loop heat pipe (16), a wood frame (17), water pipes (18), a water tank (20), a storage battery (21) and a water pump (22), wherein the support frame is fixedly provided with the two wood frames (17), the photovoltaic panel (15) is arranged between the two wood frames (17), the back face of the photovoltaic panel (15) is fixedly provided with the microchannel flat loop heat pipe (16), the upper end of the microchannel flat loop heat pipe (16) is tightly attached to the water pipes (18) through heat conducting glue, one of the two wood frames (17) is provided with the water tank (20), one side of the water tank (20) is provided with the storage battery (21), the two water pipes (18) are respectively communicated with the upper portion and the lower portion of the water tank (20) and the lower portion of the water pipe (18) is provided with the water pump (22), and the storage battery (21) is connected with the photovoltaic panel (15) and the water pump (22) through wires (19).

Claim 3: 3. The novel solar-driven tube-fin hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device is characterized in that: the tube-fin hot air drying system comprises two groups of heat insulation plates (1), oppositely-opened windows (2), supporting columns (3), heating heat exchangers (4), a drying table (5), an infrared thermometer (6), a fan (7), a condensation dehumidification heat exchanger (11), a ventilation grid (12), a hot water spray humidifier (13) and a U-shaped water outlet (14), wherein the oppositely-opened windows (2) are arranged at the opening of the heat insulation plates (1) at the outer side, a plurality of supporting columns (3) are arranged in the heat insulation plates (1) at the inner side, the drying table (5) is arranged on the heat insulation plates (1) at the inner side, the heating heat exchangers (4) are arranged above the middle part and below two sides of the drying table (5), the heating heat exchangers (4) are fixed on the corresponding supporting columns (3), the infrared thermometer (6) is fixed on the heat insulation plates (1) at the outer side, and the infrared thermometer (6) is directly opposite to the upper part of the drying table (5), it is inboard be provided with fan (7), the outside between heat insulating board (1) and the outside heat insulating board (1) the inboard of heat insulating board (1) is provided with condensation dehumidification heat exchanger (11), the both sides of condensation dehumidification heat exchanger (11) are provided with ventilation grid (12) and hot water spraying humidifier (13), just the bottom interco [excerpt ends]

Claim 4: 4. The novel solar-driven tube-fin hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device is characterized in that: the heating heat exchanger (4) is communicated with a hot water inlet (8) and a cooling water outlet (9), the bottom end of the hot water inlet (8) is communicated with a water supply pipe (24), the bottom end of the cooling water outlet (9) is communicated with a water return pipe (23), and the condensation dehumidification heat exchanger (11) is also communicated with the cooling water outlet (9).

Claim 5: 5. The novel solar-driven tube-fin hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device is characterized in that: the condensing and dehumidifying heat exchanger (11) is also communicated with a normal temperature water inlet (10).

Claim 6: 6. The novel solar-driven tube-fin hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device is characterized in that: the ventilation grids (12) are fixed between the heat insulation plates (1) on the inner side and the outer side, and the hot water spray humidifier (13) is directly opposite to the fan (7) and the ventilation grids (12).

examined_documents.title: Solar energy tobacco flue -curing house that circulates fast
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The utility model relates to a technical field of tobacco flue -curing house, more specifically relates to a solar energy tobacco flue -curing house that circulates fast. A solar energy tobacco flue -curing house that circulates fast, wherein includes locate heating device, string cigarette frame in the tobacco flue -curing house, the tobacco flue -curing house outside be equipped with the circulation greenhouse, circulation greenhouse and the inside intercommunication of tobacco flue -curing house, the tobacco flue -curing house is inside still to be equipped with indoor set and off -premises station, indoor set and outdoor unit connection, and the gas outlet of indoor set and circulation greenhouse intercommunication. The circulation greenhouse in be equipped with circulating fan, still be equipped with solar power system on the tobacco flue -curing house roof. The utility model discloses saved the space of tobacco flue -curing house, heat utilization rate is high, only goes out water and does not go out fragrance.

Claim 1: 1.一种太阳能快速循环烤烟房，其特征在于，包括设于烤烟房内的加热装置（1）、挂烟架（3），所述的烤烟房外部设有循环温室（2），循环温室（2）与烤烟房内部连通；

Claim 2: 烤烟房内部还设有室内机（4）和室外机（5），室内机（4）与室外机（5）连接，且室内机（4）的气体出口与循环温室（2）连通；所述的循环温室（2）内设有循环风机（8）；烤烟房房顶上还设有太阳能发电装置（01）。

Claim 3: 2.根据权利要求1所述的一种太阳能快速循环烤烟房，其特征在于：所述的烤烟房侧壁上设有出风口（6）和回风口（7），出风口（6）设于回风口（7）上方，室内机（4）的气体出口朝向出风口（6）；所述的室内机（4）连接有排水管，排水管连通烤烟房外部。

Claim 4: 3.根据权利要求2所述的一种太阳能快速循环烤烟房，其特征在于：所述加热装置（1）包括用于燃烧燃料输出热气的加热模块（10）、若干用于传输热气的加热管（20）、用于使加热管（20）产生的热量快速扩散到空气中的若干散热片（30）；所述加热管（20）为迂回型弯管结构，所述加热管（20）一端设有用于热气进入加热管的进气口（21）、另一端设有用于输出降温后的冷空气以及废烟废气的出气口（22）；所述加热管（20）通过进气口（21）与加热模块（10）连接，所述出气口（22）安装于烤烟房的顶部；所述若干散热片（30）安装于烤烟房的侧壁上，所述加热管（20）与散热片（30）固定安装；所述加热装置还包括环绕加热模块（10）、加热管（20）、散热片（30）整体的挡板（40）。

Claim 5: 4.根据权利要求3所述的一种太阳能快速循环烤烟房，其特征在于：所述加热管（20）为内径8cm~12cm的圆管；所述散热片（30）为散热效率高的铅板结构，所述散热片（30）为方形的散热片；所述散热片（30）的宽度为18cm~25cm。

Claim 6: 5.根据权利要求4所述的一种太阳能快速循环烤烟房，其特征在于：所述挡板（40）的高度为1.9m~2.1m，挡板（40）底部距离烤烟房地面的距离值与挡板（40）顶部距离烤烟房顶的距离值相等；所述挡板（40）底部距离烤烟房地面的距离值或挡板（40）顶部距离烤烟房顶的距离值为30cm~40cm；所述加热管（20）通过可拆卸结构与散热片（30）固定安装。

Claim 1: 建築物等に設けられたトップライトを有するアトリウムの頂部付近に滞留する熱の回収方法であって、
アトリウムの頂部付近に日射遮蔽スクリーンを設けて日射遮蔽スクリーンとアトリウムのトップライトとに囲まれた熱溜り空間を形成し、
熱交換器を有する空調機をアトリウム付近に配置して、空調機の空気の導入側と前記熱溜り空間とをダクトを介して連通するとともに、空調機の空気の吐出側と日射遮蔽スクリーンの下方の空間とをダクトを介して連通し、
空調器付近に水の貯留槽を配置して、貯留槽と前記空調機に設けられた熱交換器との間を水あるいは熱媒体が循環できるようにポンプを介して配管で接続し、熱溜り空間内に滞留している空気を空調機に導入して空調機の熱交換器で空調機に導入された空気と貯留槽内から循環された水あるいは熱媒体との間で熱交換を行って貯留槽に温水を貯留するとともに、熱溜り空間内の空気は空調機を介して日射遮蔽スクリーンの下方の空間に吹き出すことを特徴とする熱回収方法。

Claim 2: 貯留槽の上部と給湯システム系の貯湯槽とを配管で接続し、貯留槽内の温水を給湯システム系の貯湯槽に供給できるようにした請求項１に記載の熱回収方法。

examined_documents.title: Method and apparatus for recuperating heat from dryer
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: An apparatus for recuperating heat from a convection dryer comprises an exhaust air conduit having an exhaust inlet adapted to receive exhaust air from a convection dryer, and an exhaust outlet adapted to exhaust the exhaust air. An ambient air conduit has an ambient inlet adapted to receive ambient air, and an ambient outlet adapted to feed the ambient air toward a convection dryer. A heat exchanger unit has a first conduit portion within the exhaust air conduit and a second conduit portion within the ambient air conduit, the first conduit portion and the second conduit portion being arranged concurrently in a heat exchanger configuration for the ambient air to absorb heat from the exhaust air when passing therethrough. A filtering device is in the exhaust air conduit upstream of the heat exchanger unit for filtering airborne residue out of the exhaust air.

Claim 1: 1. A method for recuperating heat from a convection dryer, comprising:
receiving exhaust air from a convection dryer; receiving ambient air; filtering airborne residue out of the exhaust air; heating the ambient air by passing the exhaust air and the ambient air in a heat exchanger for the ambient air to absorb heat from the exhaust air; and feeding the heated ambient air toward the convection dryer.

Claim 2: 2. The method according to claim 1, further comprising monitoring the temperature of the exhaust air and the ambient air, and exhausting the exhaust air rather than passing same in the heat exchanger if a temperature differential between the exhaust air and the ambient air is below a given threshold.

Claim 3: 3. The method according to claim 1, further comprising monitoring a drying cycle of the convection dryer, and exhausting the exhaust air rather than passing same in the heat exchanger if the convection dryer is operating predetermined portion of the drying cycle.

Claim 4: 4. The method according to claim 1, further comprising monitoring a pressure differential across of a filter filtering the airborne residue, and vacuuming residue off the filter when the pressure differential is above a given threshold.

Claim 5: 5. The method according to claim 4, wherein vacuuming comprises automatically displacing a vacuum manifold across an upstream surface of the filter.

Claim 6: 6. The method according to claim 1, wherein receiving ambient air comprises receiving ambient air from outdoors.

evidence.title: Novel solar-driven tube-fin type heated air circulation fruit and vegetable …
evidence.quote: One side of the solar photovoltaic photothermal system is provided with tube fins Hot air drying system

section.label: Abstract
section.text: The invention relates to the field of fruit and vegetable drying, in particular to a novel solar-driven tube-fin type hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device, comprising a solar photovoltaic photothermal system and a tube-fin type hot air drying system. One side of the solar photovoltaic photothermal system is provided with tube fins Hot air drying system. This new type of solar-powered tube-fin type hot air circulation fruit and vegetable drying device uses the solar photovoltaic photothermal system to convert the absorbed solar energy into electrical energy and internal energy, which are used to drive pumps and fans, and heat the water in the water tank. High-efficiency solar energy is used. As a drying heat source, the photovoltaic photothermal system overcomes the problem of high energy consumption of the currently widely used electric hot air drying system, thereby achieving the effect of energy saving and emission reduction. The main equipment of the tube-fin type hot air drying system is a heat exchanger. Each heat exchanger is connected in parallel with the water tank to form a circulating water circuit. moisture to achieve the purpose of drying fruits and vegetables.
